subject: tf-sh
title: TF.SH.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 108 (T(AF)M-12). TF-SH (transfer shifts) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental). From LK-IMP: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and RE-DIFF. From LANG-DY: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From RE-DIFF: TRS (transition). From TRS: POL-CON (political consciousness). From PER-PHY-U-FUND: RE-ST (restructuralism). From RE-ST: LANG-DYM (language dynamics).
